description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller named SecurityController that manages user profile viewing and editing functionalities, including security checks and interactions with user and matricula repositories.

classes.name: SecurityController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling user profile display and update operations with security role restrictions.

methods.name: getUserProfile
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/profile', retrieves current user's profile and matricula list, adds them to the model.

methods.name: getForEdit
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/user/edit/{userID}', verifies user identity, and prepares user data for editing view.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Handles POST requests to '/user/edit/{userID}', updates user details after security validation.

methods.name: patchUser
methods.description: Handles POST requests to '/user/patch/{id_user}', applies partial updates to user data after validation.
